rc_by_courier_hint: SF, YTO, ZTO… sent by a supplier
rc_by_client_hint: Back from the market with their goods
rc_by_representative_hint: A relative, an employee, an agent
rc_by_pickup_hint: At the market or the supplier's

rc_no_deposits_yet: No drop-off for this customer yet.

rc_no_client_yet: No customer yet. Search by name, phone or code.
rc_s1_help: The QR in their app, or a Bonzini label. Hold it inside the frame.
rc_search_help: Type their name, phone or BZ code.
rc_s2_help: One answer. You can continue right after.
rc_s3_title: Add the parcels, one by one
rc_s3_help: One parcel at a time: photo, weight, dimensions. Then "Finish".
rc_p_photo_title: Take a photo of the parcel
rc_p_photo_help: Proof of what arrived. Tap the area to open the camera.
rc_p_weight_help: In kilos. Put it on the scale and type the number.
rc_p_dims_help: In centimetres: length, width, height. The volume is worked out for you.
rc_p_inside_help: The type, then what is inside if you know.
